commits.subject: interop-fig + folio + components (SMB-INTEROP-FIG-PROTOTYPE slice 1): PNG/JPEG frame export, prototype Folio fields, prototype player
interop-fig tests (SMB-INTEROP-FIG-PROTOTYPE slice 1 pins): JPEG q90 measured floor; easing/flow/scroll are records in fig_native and fig_export

capabilities_done: (1) export_frame_raster: PNG/JPEG frame export through interop-raster (normal edge, steward sync 76c85b3 before the push): the press render-back of the plan's page encoded as PNG (8-bit RGB) or JPEG (baseline 4:4:4, setting quality as a fraction of 100; absent quality = typed note jpeg_quality_default_used); PDF plans refused; opaque white behind a frame without painted background is a typed note

(2) Folio (additive): StudioDesignRecords.prototype_pages (STU-PRO-128/129 flow starting points {node_id, name} per page node + prototype_start_node_id) and frame_overflow (STU-PRO-138 NONE|HORIZONTAL|VERTICAL|BOTH), serde-default and not encoded when empty (byte-identical earlier record sets, test prototype_records_contract); validate_design_records refuses dangling/duplicate flow starts and overflow entries; EASING_PRESETS/easing_preset (STU-PRO-120 Studio-declared tuples). interop-fig maps prototypeStartingPoint (ordered by stored position), scrollDirection, Figma easing names to the preset tuples (CUSTOM_CUBIC keeps easingFunction) and AFTER_TIMEOUT (transitionTimeout); flow_start_not_mapped, scroll_not_mapped and the easing loss are gone

(3) components::PlayerSession: deterministic prototype player over the stored reactions: click/hover/mouse/press dispatch on node ids with ancestor bubbling, AFTER_TIMEOUT timers on an explicit ms clock, NAVIGATE (history push), OVERLAY/CLOSE, SWAP, SCROLL_TO, CHANGE_TO (runtime variant state), BACK (empty-stack diagnostic, STU-PRO-131), SET_VARIABLE (runtime variables), transitions with stored duration and cubic-bezier easing (raw and eased progress observable), navigation ends the action array (STU-PRO-104); bounded stacks (MAX_STACK 256) and actions per dispatch; diagnostics instead of silent no-ops. Proven headlessly on the Operator prototype fixture: each screen reached by dispatched clicks is rendered (PDF export + press render-back) and compared with its Operator PNG

tests.argv: cargo nextest run -p hsk-studio-interop-fig -p hsk-studio-folio -p hsk-studio-components --no-fail-fast

next: after the harness edge decision: harness viewer play mode (open .fig, PlayerSession dispatch from viewer clicks / headless steps, show the current screen through render_frame_export), proven by a headless harness test stepping the prototype fixture
